scenes.text: The first cat to ever reach space was a black and white Parisian cat named Félicette.
On October eighteenth, nineteen sixty-three, France launched her on a Véronique rocket from the Sahara in Algeria.
She flew higher than one hundred fifty kilometers, well past the edge of space.
Electrodes on her body let scientists record her brain and heart the whole time.
She floated weightless for about five minutes, and the whole flight lasted just thirteen minutes.
Her capsule came down by parachute, and she was recovered safely.
In twenty nineteen she finally got a statue. Would you trust a cat as an astronaut?

title: The first cat in space was from Paris 🐱
caption: On October 18, 1963, France sent a cat named Félicette more than 150 km up on a Véronique rocket. She was weightless for about 5 minutes and came back safely! 🚀
